punchline: They were afraid of stolen time, and then asked her to work off the clock.
thirty_sec: At a Minneapolis Wal-Mart, Ehrenreich started at $7 an hour after a drug test and a personality test. Chatting counted as time theft and breaks were punched. She said managers sometimes told staff to clock out and keep working.
question: Which rule in your team treats everyone as a suspect because of one bad case?
key_contrast: Time guarded when the worker might take it, spent freely when the company wants it.
